definition: Maize-derived feed material consisting primarily of bran separated during milling; it has by-product role and may include variable attached endosperm.

definition: A process applied to feed material to change its dimensions presentation composition moisture preservation state or separated fractions.
rationale: Replaces unsupported placeholder text with bounded feed-process scope.

definition: A feed process whose mechanism primarily applies mechanical force to cut compress shear separate agglomerate or shape material.
rationale: Defines mechanical mechanism independently of process objective.

definition: A feed process whose mechanism includes controlled heat transfer to material.
rationale: Defines thermal mechanism without assuming one output form.

definition: A feed process whose objective is reducing material moisture by natural or artificial means.
rationale: Defines moisture-removal objective without classifying every route as thermal.

definition: A moisture-removal process that reduces water content by natural or artificial means.
rationale: Separates drying process from dried material condition.

definition: A particle-size reduction process that cuts feed material into pieces.
rationale: Uses official process scope without nutritional outcome claims.

definition: A particle-size reduction process that ruptures or fragments feed material by pressure or impact.
rationale: Distinguishes crushing mechanism within particle-size reduction.

definition: A particle-size reduction process that reduces solid feed-material particles in a dry or wet process; it does not by itself establish bulk consistency moisture condition or exact particle size.
rationale: Prevents unsupported inference from grinding to dry solid bulk state.

definition: A mechanical process combining particle-size reduction with separation into flour bran and intermediate fractions.
rationale: Distinguishes fractionating flour milling from generic grinding.

definition: A grinding process using swinging or fixed hammers to reduce particle size.
rationale: Defines hammer milling as narrower grinding method.

definition: A shaping and agglomeration process in which material is compressed through a die to form pellets.
rationale: Separates pelleting process from pellet presentation.

definition: A thermo-mechanical shaping process in which material is forced through a die under pressure and heat.
rationale: Supports one Extrusion identity with thermal mechanical and shaping parents.

definition: A mechanical separation process that removes an outer hull husk shell or cortex from retained feed material.
rationale: Defines decortication as process rather than result-state adjective.

definition: A qualitative condition indicating material presented as fresh rather than governed as moisture-removed; exact moisture content remains unspecified.
